name: jjk-domain-expansion-video
description: Remotion trailer and demo videos for the Ryōiki Tenkai scroll experience

scripts.studio: npm run sync-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:trailer: npm run sync-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer-16x9 out/trailer-16x9.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer-9x16 out/trailer-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:demo: npm run sync-assets && remotion render src/index.ts Demo-16x9 out/demo-16x9.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Demo-9x16 out/demo-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:trailer && npm run render:demo && npm run finalize
